priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore cancellation of the polling interval
findings.body: The interval handle is discarded and the returned teardown function does nothing. Polling therefore continues after callers request shutdown, causing repeated stale work and potentially preventing a Node.js process from exiting.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: When callers invoke the returned cleanup function, it is now a no-op even though `attach` registered `handler` with `socket.on`. The listener therefore remains active, retains its references, and can accumulate across attach/cleanup cycles; the diff shows this PR removed the matching `socket.off` call.
